decisions.reason: Adding a Discord welcome channel and bot does not change the About page's existing project, technology, mechanics, or vision copy.
Discord welcome automation is unrelated to ETH mint conversion, pricing, swap, and refund behavior.
The Discord server configuration does not alter available mint payment currencies, selectors, or card availability.
Adding a Discord welcome channel and bot has no effect on mint tipping options or transaction flow.
The generic community language on the Mission page remains valid and is not changed by configuring Discord welcome features.
The source accepts internal Discord welcome setup but does not establish that the server is publicly available as a support channel, so the FAQ support-contact copy is not necessarily changed.
Discord welcome features do not affect NFT referral, ticket, badge, or earnings metadata.
The Discord configuration does not change prize-ticket issuance, eligibility, transfer, expiration, or reset rules.
The welcome channel and bot decision does not alter the Small Block prize amount, draw condition, funding, or winner count.
Discord welcome automation does not change automatic prize transfer or the existing winner-notification channels.
The Discord server modification is unrelated to Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or mint fulfillment.
A Discord welcome bot is not an NFT achievement badge and does not change the approved badge set, award rules, or badge display.
